entries.5725d6c9a957d502: To manage in a way that improves patients' QOL, under the management philosophy "Contribute to medicine through the development and sale of cutting-edge, superior medical devices," and centered on joint development in Japan and the United States, the company's policy is to provide medical devices of genuine value to global medical markets through the development, manufacture, import and sale of orthopedic medical devices. Based on changes in the business environment and a series of reported matters, it identifies capturing growth opportunities, improving profitability and strengthening governance as key issues, and says it will work on continuous introduction of new products responding to aging populations in Japan; in the United States, strengthening the product supply structure and improving profitability through the SAICO Project; and strengthening compliance and governance structures.
